text.p: Dutch shipping and road transport group Koninklijke Nedlloyd Groep NV said on Wednesday it expected a profit from ordinary activities for the whole of 1997.
Nedlloyd said it P&O Nedlloyd to contribute positively to the 1997 Nedlloyd result, although uncertainties in container shipping made it unwise to give a specific projection for 1997.
"Based on our current knowledge, however, we expect Nedlloyd as a whole to achieve a positive result on ordinary activities in 1997," Nedlloyd said.
"In the European Transport and Distribution sector we foresee significants improvements," it said.
"For Mammoet and other activities we expect a virtually equal result as last year," it said.
"For the other non-consolidated participations, we expect operational improvements for Martinair," it said.

"We observe, however, that the capital gains achieved by Smit International in 1996 on the sale of vessels will be absent this year," Nedlloyd said, adding other potential capital gains have not been taken into account.
